claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.conjured_weapon_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Flame Blade creates a melee weapon the caster attacks with by spending a Magic action. This is not a passive roll modifier (Bless) nor a rider on existing attacks (Hunter's Mark). It is an active per-use attack option gated by an explicit action cost. No existing OngoingOperation variant models 'spend Magic action to make a melee spell attack originating from a conjured weapon.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr or DiceAmount: abilityModifier addend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Damage is '3d6 + spellcasting ability modifier'. DiceExpr.flat is a fixed integer. There is no way to express a dynamic ability-score addend in the current DiceAmount vocabulary. The modifier changes per caster and cannot be collapsed into a flat number at authoring time.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes Fire damage equal to 3d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
